reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
commonErrors: Scoring vertebral metastases as 0 (at least one is present).
name: Revised Tokuhashi Score

version.label: Revised Tokuhashi (Tokuhashi et al. 2005)
version.detail: Six parameters, 0–15; prognostic groups 0–8 (<6 months), 9–11 (≥6 months), 12–15 (≥1 year). The original 1990 version (0–12) is different and not implemented.

purpose: Preoperative prognostic estimate for patients with metastatic spine tumours.

calculatorNotice.title: Group-level estimate
calculatorNotice.message: Developed in the authors' surgical series; modern systemic therapies have changed survival for some primaries. Not a treatment decision. Pending source verification: published tables differ for the vertebral-body metastasis item (≥3/2/1 versus ≥3/1–2/0).

options.label: Lung, osteosarcoma, stomach, bladder, oesophagus, pancreas

resultStates.label: Predicted <6 months
resultStates.summary: Score 0–8: predicted survival under 6 months in the authors' series.
resultStates.detail: Group-level estimate; integrate with oncology input, current systemic therapy options and patient goals.

resultStates.label: Predicted ≥6 months
resultStates.summary: Score 9–11: predicted survival of 6 months or more in the authors' series.

resultStates.label: Predicted ≥1 year
resultStates.summary: Score 12–15: predicted survival of 1 year or more in the authors' series.

clinicalContext.text: A widely cited prognostic score for spinal metastases.

clinicalInsights.text: Survival for some primaries (e.g. lung cancer with targeted therapy) has improved since derivation; the primary-site weights may underestimate it.

limitations.text: Derived before many modern systemic therapies.

limitations: Accuracy varies between primary tumour types.
Counting metastases depends on imaging extent.

guideSections.what: A six-parameter prognostic score for spinal metastases, 0–15.
guideSections.whenToUse: Preoperative prognostic estimation in spinal metastatic disease.
guideSections.clinicalContext: One input to multidisciplinary decisions alongside SINS, neurology and oncology.

sources.citation: Tokuhashi Y, Matsuzaki H, Oda H, Oshima M, Ryu J. A revised scoring system for preoperative evaluation of metastatic spine tumor prognosis. Spine. 2005;30(19):2186-2191.
